Spinner Saransh Jain Selected for Indian Cricket Team at 33

Off-spinner Saransh Jain has been selected for the Indian cricket team at the age of 33. Jain, who has not played in the Indian Premier League (IPL), attributed his selection to his "DNA" for off-spin bowling. He also mentioned receiving advice from Harbhajan Singh. Jain reportedly offered prayers at a Hanuman temple before his name was announced for the team.
